title: Microsoft Teams: Workflows template adds tag members to channels automatically
summary: Hold: Microsoft documents PowerShell controls for both Teams app availability and tag-management permissions, but the table reports both as undocumented. The identity guidance also confuses connection credentials with flow ownership: owners can edit or stop a flow, while departing users' connections can cause its actions to fail.

-ManageTagsPermissionMode
Determine whether team users can manage tag settings in Teams. Set this to EnabledTeamOwner to only allow Teams owners to manage tag settings in current Teams.
claims.fix: Replace controls[2].api null with kind powershell, call 'Set-CsTeamsTargetingPolicy -Identity <policy name> -ManageTagsPermissionMode <mode>', and docs https://learn.microsoft.com/powershell/module/microsoftteams/set-csteamstargetingpolicy?view=teams-ps. State that this reference documents tag-management permissions despite the manage-tags article's contrary PowerShell statement.
